top_signals.title: Japan PM Takaichi’s Public Support Slips After Cabinet Scandal
top_signals.summary: Public support for Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi slipped after a member of her cabinet resigned over a scandal, opinion polls show, but her approval ratings remain relatively strong compared to other recent premiers after a year in office.

top_signals.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
top_signals.summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

top_signals.title: U-Turn From Regulator May Be New Lifeline to Indian Derivatives
top_signals.summary: India’s battered equity-derivatives market may extend its nascent recovery after the regulator reverted to an earlier mechanism to settle prices, easing confusion that has weighed on trading activity.
